@@ -218,3 +218,93 @@ def test_get_task_title_missing(client):
 def test_get_task_title_invalid(client):
     r = client.get("/tasks/abc/title")
     assert r.status_code == 422
+
+
+def test_tasks_count_empty_and_after_create_delete(client):
+    r = client.get("/tasks/count")
+    assert r.status_code == 200
+    assert r.json() == {"count": 0}
+
+    r1 = client.post("/tasks", json={"title": "Alpha Task"})
+    assert r1.status_code == 201
+    id1 = r1.json()["id"]
+
+    r2 = client.post("/tasks", json={"title": "Beta Task"})
+    assert r2.status_code == 201
+
+    r = client.get("/tasks/count")
+    assert r.status_code == 200
+    assert r.json() == {"count": 2}
+
+    client.delete(f"/tasks/{id1}")
+    r = client.get("/tasks/count")
+    assert r.status_code == 200
+    assert r.json() == {"count": 1}
+
+def test_tasks_count_filters_q_and_status(client):
+    # Create tasks with various statuses and titles
+    r1 = client.post("/tasks", json={"title": "Python Project"})
+    id1 = r1.json()["id"]
+    client.patch(f"/tasks/{id1}", json={"status": "in_progress"})
+
+    r2 = client.post("/tasks", json={"title": "Python Script"})
+    id2 = r2.json()["id"]
+    client.patch(f"/tasks/{id2}", json={"status": "done"})
+
+    r3 = client.post("/tasks", json={"title": "JavaScript App"})
+
+    # Filter q only
+    r = client.get("/tasks/count?q=python")
+    assert r.status_code == 200
+    assert r.json() == {"count": 2}
+
+    # Filter status only
+    r = client.get("/tasks/count?status=done")
+    assert r.status_code == 200
+    assert r.json() == {"count": 1}
+
+    # Combined q and status (AND)
+    r = client.get("/tasks/count?q=python&status=in_progress")
+    assert r.status_code == 200
+    assert r.json() == {"count": 1}
+
+    # Combined no match
+    r = client.get("/tasks/count?q=python&status=done")
+    assert r.status_code == 200
+    assert r.json() == {"count": 1}
+
+    r = client.get("/tasks/count?q=javascript&status=in_progress")
+    assert r.status_code == 200
+    assert r.json() == {"count": 0}
+
+def test_tasks_count_invalid_status(client):
+    r = client.get("/tasks/count?status=invalid_status")
+    assert r.status_code == 422
+
+def test_tasks_count_unicode_and_literal_sql(client):
+    client.post("/tasks", json={"title": "Unicode 🚀 50% off test_user"})
+    
+    r = client.get("/tasks/count?q=50%")
+    assert r.status_code == 200
+    assert r.json() == {"count": 1}
+
+    r = client.get("/tasks/count?q=test_user")
+    assert r.status_code == 200
+    assert r.json() == {"count": 1}
+
+    r = client.get("/tasks/count?q=🚀")
+    assert r.status_code == 200
+    assert r.json() == {"count": 1}
+
+def test_tasks_count_does_not_modify_storage(client):
+    r1 = client.post("/tasks", json={"title": "Persistent Task"})
+    id1 = r1.json()["id"]
+
+    r_count = client.get("/tasks/count")
+    assert r_count.status_code == 200
+    assert r_count.json() == {"count": 1}
+
+    r_task = client.get(f"/tasks/{id1}")
+    assert r_task.status_code == 200
+    assert r_task.json()["title"] == "Persistent Task"
+    assert r_task.json()["status"] == "todo"
